player_puzzle_feasibility.instructions: Evaluate whether the tabletop RPG player will be able to figure out the puzzle—specifically that this chained stele is an acoustic device whose frequency can shatter his bonded ring—based strictly on the player-facing information presented to him alone.

criteria.Yes: The player has sufficient information (tonal engineer background, lute-tensioned chains, sustained acoustic pitch, unweaving frequency analysis, sympathetic ring vibration, and Molag Bal's explicit warning not to break the ring) to clearly deduce that this setup can shatter his ring.
criteria.No: The player does not have enough clear information and will fail to connect the tensioned chains to shattering his ring without additional GM prompting or the translated runes.
criteria.Roll-Dependent: The player will only deduce the specific ring-breaking function if they succeed on the Hard Magic check (-4) or observe the sympathetic ring vibration; otherwise the clues only reveal a generic acoustic instrument.
criteria.Distracted-by-Bal: The player will recognize the acoustic nature of the chains, but Molag Bal's sudden divine whisper commanding obedience will redirect their focus into a Daedric loyalty dilemma before they complete the deduction.
